interpretation: The charger is in mode 0x5 (buck + charge) with a 1500mA charge current, 1500mA input limit and 4.35V float target, but CHG_EN (C09 bit7) is clear, so charging is disabled regardless of the expired watchdog. The watchdog itself is enabled and unkicked. The battery is essentially idle at -2.3mA because VBUS powers the system. To resume charging the next step must set CHG_EN and kick or disable the watchdog, not merely wait for the watchdog.
